title: betula lutea var. alleghaniensis
intro: Betula lutea var. alleghaniensis, commonly known as yellow birch, is a deciduous tree or shrub that belongs to the family Betulaceae. The health benefits of yellow birch include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The therapeutic actions of yellow birch include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve pain, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of yellow birch include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
